summary: The candidate speaks for older homeowners by the years they paid in and the incomes that did not move, and treats the tax relief as thanks, not charity.
realLife: A state senator, a county executive and a governor each framed senior property-tax relief the same way: people who worked, paid and raised families, living on fixed incomes while bills climb, who should be able to stay in the home. One named a veteran who paid into extreme old age; one listed the teachers, nurses and shop owners among the seniors; one said no senior should lose a home to the bill.
sources: Jason Garnar, Broome County NY county executive, 2026 budget address, Sep 15, 2025: http://broomecountyny.gov/wp-content/uploads/dept/exec/pdfs/2026BudgetAddress.pdf

Kathy Hochul, New York governor, statement on signing a senior tax exemption bill, Dec 6, 2025: https://www.governor.ny.gov/news/governor-hochul-authorizes-real-property-tax-exemptions-new-york-seniors
